star.role.kiraaddon.kira.desc: Killer faction. Right-click empty-handed to mark players (10 coins/person, max 3). Marked targets are silenced and their position is exposed. Open inventory and click detonate button to detonate all marked targets (90 coins/person, kill reward 40 coins). Press G to mark current position for Bites the Dust - upon death, rewind to marked position with full HP, all players teleported to room spawn, game time rewinds 3 minutes (3/7/12/15 kills unlock 1/2/3/4 uses). Buy Sheer Heart Attack from shop (125 coins), auto-tracks targets and explodes, crouch + V to recall.
star.role.kiraaddon.josuke.desc: Sheriff faction. Use Crazy Diamond to punch players 5 consecutive times for a kill. Shield break releases a shockwave.
announcement.star.goals.kira: Use Killer Queen's abilities to eliminate all enemies. Right-click empty-handed to mark | Inventory detonate button | Press G to mark Bites the Dust position | Crouch + V to recall Sheer Heart
info.screen.roleid.kira:
Yoshikage Kira - Killer Faction

[Mark] Right-click empty-handed on players, costs 10 coins, max 3 simultaneous marks. Marked targets are silenced + position exposed
[Detonate] Click detonate button in inventory, costs 90 coins/person, explosive kill, reward 40 coins/person, 5s cooldown
[Bites the Dust] Press G to mark current position, upon death rewind and restore full HP, all players teleported to room spawn, game time rewinds 3 minutes. 3 kills→1 use, 7→2, 12→3, 15→4
[Sheer Heart Attack] Buy from shop 125 coins, auto-tracks targets within 20 blocks, expands and explodes within 3 blocks, radius 5 blocks, crouch+V to recall
[Shop] Fake Gun 10 coins | Blackout 100 coins | Lockpick 80 coins | Knife 105 coins | Sheer Heart 125 coins
